svg.title: GEAR-Nav trajectory refinement
svg.desc: Top to bottom: a café sidewalk, a rainy night sidewalk, and a market passage. Each ESDF and camera view shows the same illustrative path stages. The initial path is sampled. Later stages are authored illustrations.
